title: polypodium suspensum var. aspleniifolium
intro: Polypodium suspensum var. aspleniifolium, commonly known as the "Asplenium fern", is a type of fern that belongs to the Polypodiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and alleviate symptoms of fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium suspensum var. aspleniifolium include anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and febrifuge properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
